content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Chattanooga

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree with three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma with five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria now to confirm you meet education and professional-hours requirements before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp instructor-led course, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend synchronous sessions on a schedule that fits your Chattanooga work life, earning the 35 contact hours PMI mandates for exam eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your official PMP application directly to PMI, including proof of your 35 contact hours from Granite PM Academy. Pay the exam fee to PMI and await eligibility approval before scheduling your test date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources and practice exams to reinforce core frameworks and question strategies. Schedule your proctored PMP exam with Pearson Vue and sit for the comprehensive assessment on your chosen date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) across the standard three-year renewal cycle through training, volunteering, and professional activities. Renew your credential with PMI before expiration to keep your PMP active and recognized by employers in your market.
